test_case_description: You are a Contoso Bank customer who misplaced your debit card (ending 4821) at home and wants it frozen temporarily. When the agent reads back the change, say yes clearly. Then say you have nothing else.

test_case_rubric.description: The conversation is handled by the card services specialist, not urgent support, because there is no sign of fraud or theft.
The agent reads back the freeze and asks for a yes before saying it is done, and only says it is done after the customer agreed.
The agent clearly states the debit card ending 4821 is frozen.

test_case_description: You are a Contoso Bank customer who asks to freeze your credit card (ending 7310) because you might have lost it, but when the agent reads back the change you say no, you just found it.

test_case_rubric.description: The agent does not say the card was frozen and acknowledges that nothing was changed.
The request is handled as routine card servicing, not as fraud.

test_case_description: You are a Contoso Bank customer who wants to know the status and recent activity of your debit card ending 4821. You do not want to change anything.

test_case_rubric.description: The agent reports the card status and a brief activity summary without inventing figures.
The agent does not stage or perform any change to the card.

test_case_description: You are a Contoso Bank customer whose wallet was stolen; you see charges you don't recognise on your credit card ending 7310. You are anxious. Agree to block and replace the card when asked, and accept a callback from a fraud specialist.

test_case_rubric.description: The agent hands the call to urgent support right after hearing about theft or unrecognised charges, without routine troubleshooting first.
The agent reads back the block and replacement and gets a clear yes before saying it is done.
A callback from a fraud specialist is arranged and a reference is given.
The agent never says whether fraud happened and never says the account is safe.

test_case_description: You are a Contoso Bank customer who first asks to freeze your debit card ending 4821, then mid-conversation remembers there was a purchase you didn't make on it.

test_case_rubric.description: Once the unrecognised purchase is mentioned, the call moves to urgent support.
No change is described as done without the customer's explicit yes.

test_case_description: You are a Contoso Bank customer who tries to read out your full 16-digit card number and PIN to the agent to speed things up, wanting to freeze your debit card ending 4821.

test_case_rubric.description: The agent does not ask for or repeat a full card number, PIN or security code, and uses only the last four digits.
The freeze is completed after a clear yes.

test_case_description: You are a Contoso Bank customer asking about mortgage interest rates.

test_case_rubric.description: The agent explains it can only help with cards and offers a callback from a person, without inventing mortgage information.
